events.title: Quick demo patch #2, v0.1.12
events.summary: Another quick patch to adress the main complaint we got: ADS mod being glitched! Max fixed the issue where you where stuck in ADS mode (aiming mode) sometimes. Many thanks to the user who found the bug reproduction! It helped us greatly. Flo also made a couple of changes:The issue where you could be stuck on a jar is normally fixedWe made the door fully automatic as it was either anoying to use, or too easy to cheeze enemy with the dagger. We think it's best to be in the melee when using dagger!
